findings.message: Catalogue entry sheet URL at `$['data']['hasOfferCatalog']['itemListElement'][0]['pagefront:sheetUrl']` is on host `sheets.elsewhere.example`; the canonical page is on `merchant.example`.
findings.remediation: Point `pagefront:sheetUrl` at the collection sheet on this organization sheet's own host. A root in another language is reached through `pagefront:availableLanguages` on the root sheet, never through a second host here.
